text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear no-position in opening sentence","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a direct argumentative position right away so the reader knows the essay’s stance from the start."},{"evidence":"three numbered reasons in separate paragraphs","quality":"organized structure","description":"It develops the argument in a clearer multi-paragraph form with distinct points that are easier to follow."},{"evidence":"quotes about alert drivers, liability, and 25 mph","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It supports each reason with specific details from the article rather than mostly general statements."},{"evidence":"\"what's the point\" and repeated explanations of why it matters","quality":"reasoning development","description":"It explains why the evidence supports the claim instead of only mentioning the article facts."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement of all three reasons","quality":"argument persistence","description":"It keeps the position and supporting claims consistent from introduction through conclusion."}]}
